data.title: 艾莉莎 · 蓝调窗纱前的俄语低吟
data.description: 入夜后的卧室还没开大灯，只有床头小灯映着淡蓝色窗帘的柔波。艾莉莎赤脚立在落地窗纱旁，手指无意识地攥着雪白蕾丝裙摆一角，察觉到身后灼热目光后耳尖瞬间染红，用极轻的俄语小声嘀咕着「别一直盯着看呀」。
data.location: 微风拂动轻纱的深夜卧室落地窗边
data.action: 背靠窗纱微微侧身，指尖轻捻裙边，耳尖绯红地别开视线
data.lighting: 窗外冷冽靛蓝夜色与床头柔暖微光的柔和交融
data.camera: 中近景平视，聚焦锁骨银结与羞怯神态
data.mood: 矜持、娇羞、藏不住的少女心动
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot beside the sheer bedroom curtains after dusk, Alya pinches the scalloped lace hem of her pale ice-blue silk slip dress and glances sideways with a vivid blush. Cool blue twilight from the window meets the warm glow of a bedside lamp across her silver hair and bare shoulders.
data.animaCaption: She stands barefoot by the sheer window curtains, fingers nervously holding her lace hem while looking away with flushed cheeks.
data.nsfwProse: The frosted white lace neckline frames her collarbone and slender shoulders while the soft silk slip follows her waist in the dim lamp light.
